name: cavemio-action-receipt
title: Action receipts
description: What the agent actually did, one quiet line each, with Undo while a ring drains. Several stack into one.

cavemio.accessibility:
- Undo buttons are labelled with the action ("Undo: Added “Soft launch” to Saturday"); undoing, undone and failures are announced.
- The ring drains with a CSS animation, so nothing re-renders every frame; Undo folds away exactly when the window closes, and the ring pauses once it has faded out.
- Installs Number roll and Text morph. With reduced motion, states change in place.
- Colour is never the only signal: failed lines show the reason, and undone lines are struck through and labelled.
- Always enforce the undo window on the server too; the ring only shows it.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: actions
props.type: { id; title; detail?; icon?; status?; error?; undoUntil? }[]
props.description: – · One per action. status is "done", "undoing", "undone" or "failed"; undoUntil (ms) enables Undo.

props.name: onUndo
props.description: – · Shows Undo while the window is open, with a spinner until the promise settles. Set the action’s status to "undone" after.

props.name: onUndoAll
props.description: – · For the stacked "Undo all"; defaults to calling onUndo for each undoable action.

props.name: stackFrom
props.description: 3 · Fold into a summary from this many actions; 0 never folds.

props.name: undoWindow
props.description: 10000 · Length of the undo window (ms), so the ring drains at the right pace.

useCases.title: AI agent chats
useCases.description: Show each thing the agent did, such as sending an email or moving a file, as a line the person can check.

useCases.title: Calendar and inbox assistants
useCases.description: Assistants that change real data, where a wrong action needs a quick way back.

useCases.title: Automation run logs
useCases.description: After a workflow runs, list what it changed, with a short window to undo each step.

useCases.title: Bulk actions
useCases.description: “Archived 12 customers” with Undo all, instead of a confirm dialog before the fact.

features.title: Every action is a line
features.description: What happened and where, with an icon, as soon as your tool finishes.

features.title: Undo for a limited time
features.description: A small ring drains while the window is open, then Undo folds away. Your server still decides what can be undone.

features.title: Undo shows its progress
features.description: Undo becomes Undoing with a spinner, then a strike draws across the line and it reads Undone.

features.title: Failures say why
features.description: A failed action shows the reason in place of the detail and offers Retry.

features.title: Many actions fold into one
features.description: From three actions on they become “4 actions · Undo all”, with the counts updating as things change.

features.title: Labelled for screen readers
features.description: Each Undo button names its action, and undoing, undone and failures are announced.

states.title: done
states.description: Icon, what happened and where. Undo with a ring that drains until undoUntil, then Undo folds away (420ms).

states.title: undoing
states.description: The ring blurs into a spinner and "Undo" morphs to "Undoing" while your onUndo promise runs.

states.title: undone
states.description: A strike draws itself across the title (480ms) as it fades to muted; the button settles on "Undone".

states.title: failed
states.description: The icon swaps to a red cross, the reason replaces the detail, and the button reads Retry.

states.title: stacked
states.description: From stackFrom actions: overlapping icons and "4 actions · 1 undone", where counts roll and parts open in as they apply. Undo all spins and morphs to "Undoing all" while it runs.
